messages:
Alex Kim: Quick handoff from the obs-rfc — we need to agree on the trace enrichment contract for cost attribution before eng-sre starts the pipeline changes.
Maya Patel: Thanks Alex. which fields are we locking down now vs. iterate later?
Alex Kim: We should lock: billing_key, cost_bucket, sampling_reason. Optional for now: customer_labels (freeform), experiment_tag.
Kevin Zhou: Agree on required set. +1 on keeping customer_labels optional because cardinality concerns.
Sophie Lee: For sampling_reason do we want a short enum or free text? enums are easier to aggregate.
Alex Kim: Enum. proposed set: {PROD_SAMPLER, TRACE_SAMPLER, MANUAL_DEBUG, LEGACY}. can add later.
Maya Patel: How do we attach billing_key at the trace vs span level? single source of truth on the root span?
Kevin Zhou: Root span only. spans can carry a local ref but cost calculation uses the root billing_key. avoids duplication.
Sophie Lee: What about partial failures where root span lost (ingest sampler)? fallback should attempt to use span.billing_key then tag.service owner. we should doc fallback order.
Alex Kim: Yes: 1) root.billing_key 2) span.billing_key 3) header X-Redwood-Billing 4) tag.service_owner. We'll include that in the contract.
Maya Patel: Retention and cardinality: if customer_labels present we should throttle enrichment expansions. propose we hash any freeform label values and keep a separate low-cardinality index for human-readable values.
Kevin Zhou: Hashing is fine. Also add a max cardinality guard for cost_bucket dimension (e.g., 10k unique keys/day) with an opt-in for enterprise.
Sophie Lee: For telemetry pipeline: should enrichment happen pre-sampling or post-sampling? I think pre-sampling to ensure billing attribution is preserved.
Maya Patel: Pre-sampling guarantees attribution but increases processing. we can do lightweight enrichment (keys only) pre-sample and full enrichment post-sample for retained traces.
Alex Kim: Yes — two-step: minimal key enrichment during frontdoor (cheap lookups), then full attribute join in batch/async. document expected latency: near-real-time keys, full attrs within 30s.
Kevin Zhou: Example schema snippet for root attributes: ```json
{"billing_key":"string","cost_bucket":"string","sampling_reason":"enum","customer_labels_hashed":["string"]}
```
Sophie Lee: Nice. Any change to trace IDs or formats? we must not mutate trace_id.
Alex Kim: No changes to trace_id. enrichment must be idempotent. add idempotency key in contract: enrichment_version.
Maya Patel: Ops concerns: if enrichment service is down use a fail-open policy (mark billing_key = 'unknown' and route to low-cost tier). Is that acceptable?
Kevin Zhou: Acceptable as default. add alerting on missing billing_key > 1% of traffic per minute.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: enrichment-service v2 will be deployed to staging at 2026-04-12T18:00Z.
Sophie Lee: Follow-up tasks: @Maya to write contract doc, @Kevin to add cardinality guards, @Alex to update rollout playbook.
Alex Kim: I'll draft the contract doc tonight and link to the RFC. thanks all. :thumbsup:
